<title level="1" right="Rules">[Alchemical Bombs](/Rules.aspx?ID=242)</title>

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 292 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Alchemical bombs are consumable weapons that deal damage or produce special effects, and they sometimes deal splash damage. For more on alchemical bombs, see page 544.

 [Lesser acid flask](/Equipment.aspx?ID=74), [lesser alchemist's fire](/Equipment.aspx?ID=75), [lesser bottled lightning](/Equipment.aspx?ID=76), [lesser frost vial](/Equipment.aspx?ID=77), [lesser tanglefoot bag](/Equipment.aspx?ID=78), [lesser thunderstone](/Equipment.aspx?ID=79)
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
